reaction_adv_carpenter.txt fixture -- see PROVENANCE.md.

RECONSTRUCTED reaction. The audit verifies two real patterns from this
file: the tool reagent uses PRESERVE_REAGENT plus HAS_EDGE (audit sec1,
"tool in nearly every carpenter reaction"), and every product in this file
inherits its material from the log reagent with no fixed material anywhere
(audit sec2, "22/22 reagent-inherited... every piece of furniture/tool made
from log inherits whatever wood the carpenter used"). Because the log
reagent itself names no fixed material (WOOD covers any species, chosen
at the job), this reaction's product has nothing in material_reaction_
products to join against in pass 2 -- a genuinely unresolved case distinct
from the BAG_ITEM family mismatch, not a lookup gap.

[OBJECT:REACTION]

[REACTION:MAKE_WOODEN_CHAIR]
	[NAME:make wooden chair]
	[BUILDING:CARPENTERS:NONE]
	[SKILL:CARPENTRY]
	[REAGENT:log:1:WOOD:NONE:NONE:NONE]
	[REAGENT:tool:1:NONE:NONE:NONE:NONE]
		[PRESERVE_REAGENT]
		[HAS_EDGE]
	[PRODUCT:100:1:CHAIR:NONE:GET_MATERIAL_FROM_REAGENT:log:NONE]
